newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGOLAISE BUYS 35% OF UGANDAN BANK.
newsitem.headline: BELGOLAISE BUYS 35% OF UGANDAN BANK.

text.p: Belgian bank Belgolaise said it had taken a 35 percent equity stake in Uganda's Sembule Commercial Bank Ltd.
"Sembule Commercial Bank thus becomes a full member of Belgolaise's African network of affiliated banks," Belgolaise said in an article in its bi-monthly "Bulletin" publication.
The acquisition was completed last November when Sembule changed its name and structure. No financial details were given.
No one at Belgolaise, a unit of Generale Bank , was immediately available to comment.
Under an earlier agreement, Sembule had served as Belgolaise's representative office in Uganda.
